{{Quote|Wonderful food!|Max Rebo comments on bantha kabobs|<ref name="TFJP" />}}
A '''bantha kabob''' was a dish made with cooked [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] meat that was [[Diet/Legends|edible]] by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]].<ref name="TFJP" /> Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]] kabobs' appearance in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]" takes place a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the part of the story that is concurrent with {{Film|VI}}, the events of which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the Ortolan [[Music/Legends|musician]] [[Max Rebo/Legends|Max Rebo]] enjoyed several bantha kabobs&mdash;a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] he had never had before&mdash;in a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He initially started with one but was so impressed with the kabobs' flavor that he had a waiter bring him two more, admiring the meat's perfect cook that resulted in shades of [[Color/Legends|pink]], gray, and yellow as well as delightfully sharp&ndash;tasting grease.<ref name="TFJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bantha kabobs appeared in "[[And the Band Played On: The Band's Tale]]," a short story written by [[John Gregory Betancourt]] and published in the ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' story collection in [[1995]].<ref name="TFJP" />
